Connected wings, exposed boundaries and constructed window openings. Every part is generated in Aether.

What this bench proves

Window apertures are open wall rings with chamfers, depth, gaskets and inset glazing. Shared wing walls are removed before meshing. Massing and facade seeds vary independently.

This prototype explores a rectilinear construction family. Aether’s existing curved families remain available in Architecture Lab. City-wide integration, curved facade grammars, interiors and final art direction are subsequent work.
